model.passMapping: INSUFFICIENT_DATA => PASS; retain reasons; probabilities, predictedClass and correct1X2 null

dataContract.score: fullTimeHomeGoals/fullTimeAwayGoals; regulation time including stoppage; fixtureStatus FT
dataContract.invalid: Hash mismatch, duplicate identity, missing/invalid required field, unexpected league/season/status/count, noninteger scores outside 0..100 or team identity mismatch => INVALID; do not silently drop rows
dataContract.targetLabels: Join actual scores/class only after prediction and PASS record is sealed; never pass target scores to predictor

sort: kickoffUtc ASC by UTC epoch milliseconds
temporal.pool: Expanding archived context from seasons 2023 and 2024; effective inputs retain the existing 365-day model lookback
temporal.eligibility: same league; context season; prior ID != target ID; prior kickoff < cutoff; derivedResearchAvailableAt < cutoff; prior kickoff >= cutoff - 365 days
temporal.sameKickoffPolicy: One immutable pre-group eligible history for all targets sharing kickoff; fixture ID orders execution only; no within-group result updates
temporal.legacyAdapter: Future research runner only: map derivedResearchAvailableAt into legacy resultObservedAt parameter in memory with explicit false provenance sidecar; never persist this alias, backfill archive observedAt or claim actual observation
temporal.limitation: 48 hours is a fixed research assumption, not actual final whistle/observation evidence. Multi-day suspensions or retrospective corrections may violate it. Contrary reliable completion evidence invalidates affected evaluation pending a new prospective protocol; no ad hoc outcome-driven exceptions.

output.counts: Training count = model evidence competitionMatches; home/away relevant counts = homeVenueMatches/awayVenueMatches; latest kickoff is max eligible kickoff or null
output.actualClass: home goals > away goals HOME; equal DRAW; otherwise AWAY
output.invalidProbability: Nonfinite, outside [0,1], or sum outside tolerance => INVALID; no external renormalization

metrics.cohort: All and only Poisson PREDICTED targets, in frozen target order; no outcome-dependent exclusions
metrics.coverage: PREDICTED_MATCHES / TOTAL_TARGET_MATCHES; PASS stays in target denominator
metrics.logLossFloorReporting: Count pActual < floor; floor for scoring only, never alter stored probabilities
metrics.brier: mean(sum over HOME,DRAW,AWAY of (pClass - indicatorActualClass)^2); unscaled, range 0..2
metrics.classCounts: All class predicted/actual/correct counts use PREDICTED cohort, not all targets; confusion matrix rows actual, columns predicted
metrics.drawRecall: DRAW correct count / DRAW actual count in PREDICTED cohort
metrics.means: Arithmetic mean of each probability on PREDICTED cohort
metrics.zeroDenominator: null (not 0); counts remain integers, empty calibration bins remain visible
metrics.precision: IEEE-754 binary64; aggregate unrounded values in frozen target order; rounding for display only

calibration.empty: count 0, mean/frequency null, lowSample true; retain all 30 bins

comparator.name: ELIGIBLE_HISTORY_EMPIRICAL_1X2
comparator.formula: Counts of HOME/DRAW/AWAY regulation results divided by number of same eligible training matches; no smoothing
comparator.comparisonCohort: Same Poisson PREDICTED targets only; report paired count; missing comparator on this cohort => INVALID
comparator.metrics: Same accuracy, log loss (same floor), Brier, class counts/recall, probability means and calibration; no alternative comparator selection

classification.insufficient: PREDICTED count below minimum OR any actual outcome class count on PREDICTED cohort below minimum
classification.baseline: Valid protocol and both reporting sufficiency floors met, irrespective of measured performance
classification.thresholdRationale: Preregistered reporting guardrails, not statistical power or model input thresholds
classification.promising: Never automatic; separate CTO review annotation only after the frozen baseline report

governance.network: None in future offline backtest or protocol tests
governance.privateData: No owner risk manager/ledger/private data reads or writes
governance.archive: Read-only local archive; no raw data publication
governance.changeControl: No performance-dependent tuning, lag sweep, minimum changes or selective reporting. Changes require a new prospective protocol/version and separate review. This commit authorizes no backtest execution.

hashPolicy: SHA256 of UTF8 canonical JSON: recursively sort object keys, preserve array order, JSON.stringify with no whitespace or trailing newline; hash stored separately to avoid self-reference
